finding.title: Extract a shared pumpApp/l10n test harness — 25+ duplicated MaterialApp+delegate blocks across features/profiles/presentation tests
finding.why: grep -c 'GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate' across the 15 batch files totals 25 occurrences in 13/15 files (7 alone in parent_pin_keypad_dialog_test.dart, 3 each in add_profile_dialog_test.dart and parent_track_management_screen_l1_test.dart) — every widget test hand-rolls its own MaterialApp(locale:, localizationsDelegates: const [4 delegates], supportedLocales:, home:) wrapper. No pumpApp helper exists anywhere in test/ (repo-wide search). This is Fowler-textbook shotgun-surgery risk: adding a 5th delegate, changing supportedLocales, or fixing an RTL default requires touching dozens of call sites, and drift has already started — pp11_edit_dialog_autofocus_test.dart and pp13 write the delegate list without 'const' while most others use 'const ['.
finding.recommendation: Add test/helpers/pump_app.dart exporting a pumpApp(tester, {required Widget child, Locale locale = const Locale('en'), List<Override> overrides = const [], StackRouter? router}) that wraps ProviderScope+MaterialApp+the 4 delegates+supportedLocales once; migrate these 15 files onto it incrementally.
acceptance_criteria: test/helpers/pump_app.dart exists and is imported by at least the files in this batch.
grep -rc 'GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate' test/features/profiles/presentation/ drops from 25 to 0 outside the new shared helper.

finding.title: Close or auto-close inMemoryDb() in profiles _buildApp test helpers — 3 files leak native Drift handles whenever db: is omitted

evidence.quote:
/// Callers MUST `await db.close()` in `tearDown` to free the native
/// resources.

finding.why: drift_memory.dart's own contract says callers MUST close inMemoryDb(). In these 3 files, _buildApp (and _buildAppLoading/_buildAppError, which have no db: parameter at all) construct one via `db ?? inMemoryDb()` whenever the optional db: is omitted, and the large majority of testWidgets in parent_settings_screen_l1_test.dart and parent_track_management_screen_l1_test.dart (~30 of ~40 across the two files) do omit it, so each test run leaks a native sqlite3 in-memory connection nothing ever closes — the caller has no reference to the db, so it can't be closed even in a teardown. At the scale of this test suite (dozens of files following the same pattern), this is a plausible contributor to CI slowness or file-descriptor/memory pressure.
finding.recommendation: Make db a required parameter (as ts3_parent_track_archive_test.dart already does correctly, forcing every call site to own+close it), or have _buildApp itself call addTearDown(() => resolvedDb.close()) so omitting db: is automatically safe.
acceptance_criteria: Every _buildApp/_buildAppLoading/_buildAppError variant in these 3 files either requires db: or internally registers addTearDown to close the database it created.

finding.title: Rewire pp16/ts14 regression assertions onto the real widget — pp16 tests Flutter's SliverGrid math instead of ProfileGrid's config, ts14's second test reads a bare ARB getter instead of the rendered archive dialog
finding.why: pp16's two tests only import package:flutter/rendering.dart and flutter_test — they never import ProfileGrid (profile_grid.dart), instead constructing SliverGridDelegateWithMaxCrossAxisExtent/WithFixedCrossAxisCount from scratch and asserting on Flutter's own layout math. Currently ProfileGrid does use maxCrossAxisExtent:260 (profile_grid.dart:39-40), so the test's numbers happen to agree today, but nothing in the test file would notice if that gridDelegate: argument were changed, removed, or reverted to FixedCrossAxisCount(2) — the exact PP-16 bug the file claims to guard. Similarly, ts14's second test reads AppLocalizations.of(context)!.parentDeleteTrackArchiveBody directly and asserts on its string content instead of opening the real archive dialog (as the sibling ts3 test's intent describes) and reading the rendered Text — it cannot catch _showDeleteDialog being edited to reference the sibling own-profile key deleteTrackArchiveBody instead.
finding.recommendation: pp16: pump the real ProfileGrid widget at the wide-tablet viewport and read its actual gridDelegate/tile RenderBox size instead of re-instantiating a delegate. ts14: extend a widget test that opens the real _showDeleteDialog via longPress and asserts the rendered dialog body Text equals l10n.parentDeleteTrackArchiveBody.
acceptance_criteria: Reverting profile_grid.dart:39 to SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(crossAxisCount: 2, ...) fails pp16's test suite.
Swapping parent_track_management_screen.dart's dialog content to l10n.deleteTrackArchiveBody (the own-profile key) fails ts14's suite.

finding.title: Split 4 oversized hand-written test files in features/profiles/presentation (805-1079 lines) — over the AG-3 400-line cap
finding.why: parent_pin_keypad_dialog_test.dart (1079 lines), parent_settings_screen_l1_test.dart (999), parent_track_management_screen_l1_test.dart (902), and profile_picker_screen_l1_test.dart (805) each run 2-2.7x over the 400-line AG-3 cap, each covering many unrelated scenario groups (e.g. parent_settings mixes the tutor-permission-tile matrix, the Adjust-Points dialog, and the Pending-Prizes subtitle in one file/one main()), which is harder to navigate and increases merge-conflict surface on churned files.
finding.recommendation: Split each by scenario group, mirroring the ppNN/tsN per-scenario file convention already used elsewhere in this same directory (e.g. peel Adjust-Points-dialog and Pending-Prizes tests out of parent_settings_screen_l1_test.dart into their own files).
acceptance_criteria: `find learning_tracker/test -name '*.dart' | xargs wc -l | awk '$1>400'` reports zero files under test/features/profiles/presentation/.

finding.title: Scope or ticket the FlutterError.onError overflow suppression in profile_picker_screen_l1_test.dart and rpr2_picker_offline_delete_test.dart he-locale tests
finding.why: Both overrides swallow every RenderFlex-overflow FlutterError raised anywhere in the pumped tree for the remainder of the test, not just the one 'residual small profile-grid' overflow the comment names, and neither comment cites a Linear DNI-#### id (only 'tracked for the Phase 8 RTL/visual sweep'). Any new, unrelated overflow introduced later in the Hebrew-locale render of ProfilePickerScreen (or, in rpr2, the manage-sheet/confirm-dialog chain) will pass silently instead of failing CI, on an RTL app where directional-layout overflow is a named risk (AX-1).
finding.recommendation: Narrow the filter to the specific known widget (match its key/type in the error details), or replace the blanket catch with a `// TODO(DNI-####): remove once <widget> RTL overflow is fixed` plus a scoped skip, so unrelated future overflows still fail the test.
acceptance_criteria: Introducing a synthetic RenderFlex overflow in an unrelated widget within the same pumped tree causes these two tests to fail again.
